capabilities.shows: GET /capabilities of a single-graph server whose graph has its mask: `pattern` in features and routes, the block available (basic, mask file, placement record)

traverse_capabilities.shows: GET /traverse/capabilities (the document the service probe reads) on the same server: the same `pattern` block

capabilities_mask_absent.shows: the mini index as built, without its .edgemask: the feature and route listed, the block available false, unavailable_reason mask_required, mask absent

traverse_capabilities_mask_absent.shows: the same unmasked server on the probe route

capabilities_built_at_load.shows: the mini index as built, served with --pattern-build-mask: the block available, mask built_at_load (the mask built in memory at start-up), otherwise as with the file

traverse_capabilities_built_at_load.shows: the same server on the probe route

capabilities_multi_graph.shows: a multi-graph server: no `pattern` feature or route; the block says multi_graph_later_increment and nothing else

traverse_capabilities_multi_graph.shows: the multi-graph server probed for one graph: the same reduced block

traverse_capabilities_primary.shows: a PRIMARY index (wrapped in CanonicalDBG): graph_mode primary, scopes [any_offset], strand_stated false, placement none_canonical, annotation unbudgeted (column)

capabilities_representation_unsupported.shows: a graph the engine does not recognise (a hash graph): the feature and route listed, the block available false, unavailable_reason representation_unsupported, graph_mode null and only k set

traverse_capabilities_representation_uns.shows: the same hash-graph server on the probe route

count.shows: mode count, scope any_offset and strands both by default: exact context counts with suffix, by_offset (every offset, zeros included) and by_strand; labels and occurrences unknown; no results; an absent primer counts exact 0

count_suffix.shows: scope suffix: only offset k - L, absence_scope suffix_only; an exact 11-mer (22 bits) is admitted in this scope however short

count_forward.shows: strands forward: P only, strands ["+"], by_strand {"+"}

count_iupac.shows: IUPAC patterns (the 16S V4 primers 515F and 806R): kind iupac, fractional information_bits

count_palindrome.shows: a palindromic pattern: searched once, palindromic true, strands ["="], by_strand {"both"}

count_low_complexity.shows: a repeat sdust flags: notes ["low_complexity_pattern"] (here with no context)

count_long.shows: L > k in mode count: scope long, counts.anchors (anchor window [0, k)) and counts.paths unknown, anchor_information_bits, note paths_later_increment; no anchor: paths exact 0

information_floor.shows: error slots information_below_floor (22 bits; 20 bits; a long pattern whose anchor window has 22): the slot keeps the pattern's description, the others are answered

bad_alphabet.shows: error slots bad_alphabet (U, an IUPAC code in a dna pattern, X, an empty pattern): only id, kind and error; the last pattern is answered

clamped.shows: request values above the server caps are lowered and listed in limits.clamped {field, requested, effective}, never refused

all_or_count.shows: mode and output omitted: all_or_count with output.labels "none"; every context returned (kmer, instance, offset, strand, node, row) in (node, offset, orientation) order, retrieval_complete true; the absent primer: results [] and complete

all_or_count_iupac.shows: an IUPAC pattern retrieved: each result's instance is the matched variant (Y, M resolved), rc(P)'s instances on strand "-"

all_or_count_suffix.shows: retrieval in scope suffix (offset k - L only, absence_scope suffix_only); the palindrome's contexts carry strand "="

all_or_count_withheld.shows: the exact count (24) above max_contexts (10): results withheld, withheld.reason count_above_threshold, returned 0, no cut

partial_cut.shows: mode partial: the first 5 contexts in answer order, cut.reason max_contexts, retrieval_complete false, the count exact

stop_at_threshold.shows: stop_at_threshold: discovery stops once the count passes max_contexts: at_least, stop {discovery, max_contexts}, withheld threshold_crossed

max_steps.shows: max_steps reached in discovery: at_least counts, stop {discovery, max_steps}, withheld discovery_budget; the request's budget is spent, so the next pattern answers unknown counts with the same stop

max_steps_partial.shows: the same stop in mode partial: what discovery found is delivered, cut.reason max_steps; the second pattern returns nothing, cut max_steps

max_steps_bounds.shows: max_steps reached in a mask scan (scope suffix, a record-start pattern whose count needs one): stop {mask_scan, max_steps}, the count bounds {value = lower, upper} with the strand that finished exact; bounds + exact = bounds

max_steps_bounds_withheld.shows: the same stop in all_or_count: bounds, withheld discovery_budget

deadline.shows: a 251 ms budget (1 ms of work before the 250 ms finalisation reserve): stop {discovery, time}, withheld deadline, determinism time_limited; the next pattern unknown (counts and work of time_limited patterns vary between runs)

deadline_partial.shows: the deadline in mode partial: nothing is released after a time stop in discovery (its membership would depend on the machine): returned 0, cut.reason time

max_steps_then_time.shows: partial, discovery stopped by max_steps, then the release meets the work time: stop keeps the first stop {discovery, max_steps}, the time shows only as cut.reason time and determinism time_limited (how many were released varies between runs); the next pattern answers the sticky max_steps stop, its empty release past the work time: cut time, returned 0, time_limited

long.shows: L > k in all_or_count: anchors counted, paths unknown, withheld paths_later_increment; with no anchor the empty answer is complete (anchors and paths exact 0)

primary_any_offset.shows: a PRIMARY index: results carry orientation (forward, reverse) instead of strand, by_orientation instead of by_strand, note strand_unknown_canonical; node is the wrapper id

primary_suffix.shows: scope suffix on a PRIMARY index: error slot scope_unsupported (a virtual suffix is a stored prefix); any_offset is complete there

labels_all.shows: output.labels "all" within the threshold: every context with its labels (column, support kmer) and their placed occurrences (seq_id, record, strand, 1-based nt_coords, nt_length; the record mapping of the .seqs first, the offset after), by_label (contexts desc, column asc) with the deduplicated occurrences, counts.labels and counts.occurrences exact, placement record, annotation budgeted; the absent primer: complete, exact zeros

labels_all_withheld.shows: output.labels "all" above the threshold: the count is not admitted, no annotation row is read (work.annotation_rows 0), withheld count_above_threshold, labels and occurrences unknown, by_label null

labels_all_truncated.shows: max_labels_per_anchor 2 below the rows' 9 labels: all_or_count withholds (anchor_labels_truncated) and lists each truncated anchor (kmer, row, cap, total) so that the cap to ask for is known

labels_all_truncated_partial.shows: the same cap in mode partial: every context returned, its labels_status "truncated" with labels_total 9 and the first 2 labels (ascending column), the counts at_least, retrieval_complete false

labels_all_partial.shows: mode partial with the label caps: the first 3 contexts (cut max_contexts), the first 2 labels in label order (labels_cut), each label's first occurrence of its union (occurrences_cut); the counts over the returned contexts, at_least

labels_all_work_budget.shows: max_annotation_work 1: the first read passes the budget, the reads stop (stop {label_discovery, max_annotation_work}), all_or_count withholds (annotation_budget); the budget is the request's: the next pattern reads nothing

labels_all_work_budget_partial.shows: the same stop in mode partial: every context returned, the row read first with its labels, the others labels_status "not_read" (labels null); counts at_least, retrieval_complete false

labels_all_global.shows: coordinates without the record mapping (--no-coord-mapping): placement global, each label's occurrence_list holds (kmer_coord, offset, strand), nothing is placed in a record (counts.occurrences unknown), note record_bounds_unknown

labels_all_count.shows: mode count with output.labels "all": counted, no annotation read, output null, the note annotation_not_read says the projection had no effect

annotation_unbudgeted.shows: 400 annotation_unbudgeted: output.labels "all" on an annotation without the budget-aware decode (a column annotation), unless the request allows it

labels_all_unbudgeted.shows: the same with allow_unbudgeted_annotation: labels read without a memory bound on the reads (annotation unbudgeted, note annotation_unbudgeted); a PRIMARY index places nothing (placement none_canonical)

unknown_field.shows: 400 invalid_request: a field nothing reads is refused, never ignored

too_many_patterns.shows: 400 invalid_request: more patterns than the server's max_patterns (16): a list is refused, never cut

later_increment_labels.shows: 400 later_increment: output.labels "predicate_only" (the labels a predicate names) is not served yet (capabilities projections_later_increment; "all" is served since increment 3)

later_increment_graphs.shows: 400 later_increment: the request field graphs (multi-graph selection) is refused by name, whatever its value

resident_only.shows: 400 resident_only: in_ram, whatever its value (the route never loads an index)

mask_required.shows: 400 mask_required: the graph has no dummy-edge mask, whatever the request asks

multi_graph.shows: 400 later_increment on a multi-graph server, whatever the request

representation_unsupported.shows: 400 representation_unsupported: a graph the engine does not recognise (a hash graph), whatever the request asks

deadline_503.shows: HAND-MADE: 503 deadline, the answer could not be written by time_budget_ms (nothing partial is sent)

initializing_503.shows: HAND-MADE: 503 while the index loads (every route; no code; Retry-After: 60)
